attributes.name: Druva - Administrator Login From Multiple IPs
attributes.description: Detects an administrator authenticating from three or more distinct IP addresses within the rule observation window.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.external_dependency: Threat intelligence / VPN-TOR enrichment; GeoIP/location enrichment
meta.customer_usecase: Detects an administrator authenticating from three or more distinct IP addresses within the rule observation window.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND druva.event_type == "Admin Login"

| EVAL admin = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.name),
    TO_STRING(user.email)
  )

| EVAL login_ip = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip)
  )

| EVAL location =
    TO_STRING(source.ip)

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| WHERE admin IS NOT NULL
    AND login_ip IS NOT NULL

| STATS
    login_count = COUNT(*),
    ip_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(login_ip),
    ip_addresses = VALUES(login_ip),
    locations = VALUES(location),

    first_login = MIN(event_time),
    last_login = MAX(event_time),

    first_ip = FIRST(login_ip, event_time),
    last_ip = LAST(login_ip, event_time),

    first_location =
      FIRST(location, event_time),

    last_location =
      LAST(location, event_time)

  BY admin

| WHERE ip_count >= 3
